Appear for the interview on 16-11-2026 at 10.00 AM at the office of the Associate Director of Research, UAS, Dharwad.

content_sections.text: Temporary engagement until 31.03.2027 or the end of the project tenure, whichever is earlier Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving any reason Appointment does not entitle the candidate to any permanent appointment in the University Affidavit in Format TR-2 on Rs. 100/- stamp paper must be submitted before joining

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 20,000 + 16% HRA per DST guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. (Agri.)/B.Sc.; preferable M.Sc. in Microbiology/M.Sc. (Agri.) in Biotechnology; must have hands-on experience with duckweed, microalgae and spirulina cultivation, nutritional profile analysis and basic biochemical and molecular biology techniques.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Hands-on experience with duckweed, microalgae and spirulina cultivation is a must. Candidates attend the interview at their own expense.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview at the office of the Associate Director of Research, UAS, Dharwad on 16-11-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary engagement until 31.03.2027 or the end of the project tenure, whichever is earlier. Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving any reason. Appointment does not entitle the candidate to any permanent appointment in the University.

faq.answer: Department of Biotechnology, College of Agriculture, Dharwad.
